caption:
An -ing subject takes a singular verb.

"Restoring old maps requires patience." The subject is the activity, not "maps." Swap the phrase for "it" to check.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: "Restoring old maps requires…" One activity = singular verb.

youtube.title: SAT Agreement: -ing Subjects Take Singular Verbs
youtube.description: A gerund phrase like "restoring old maps" is one activity, so it takes a singular verb. Swap it for "it" to check.
